prior_round_results.round1: latency and joint coverage below 0.99; retained without tuning
prior_round_results.round2: formal fit attempt invalidated at 2680/2880 windows by throttled=0x80008 under the performance governor

frequency_telemetry: record per-window scaling_cur_freq at start and end on every online CPU; report but do not use as a fit or validity condition
batch_semantics: All n_records for a decision window are transformed together and passed to the resident portable NumPy action as one batch. Model load/switch cost is excluded here and measured separately.

background_conditions.description: one logical CPU at 50 percent duty
one logical CPU at 100 percent duty

split_order_rule: Run fit, then margin, fit predictors and freeze margins, then run coverage. Never inspect coverage to tune predictors or margins.
condition_order: Seeded random permutation independently within each split
row_schedule: Seeded permutation of the 6000 frozen scheduler_train rows, cycling only after exhaustion
latency_predictor: Per-action, per-workload, per-background empirical fit-split Q0.99 lookup under the fanless-safe ondemand governor
thermal_predictor: Ordinary least squares on fit split using the separately frozen Round 3 predictor configuration
fixed_buffer_rationale: Frozen before Round 3 data: the latency buffer rounds up the largest Round 1 by-action Q0.99 shortfall beyond its frozen upper bound (9.67791 ms); the thermal buffer rounds up the largest Round 1 observed shortfall (0.590156 C). These are a new-round design response, not changes to Round 1 results.
coverage_rule: Report marginal, joint, and by-action empirical coverage only; do not tune on coverage
invalid_if: any current undervoltage or throttle low-nibble bit is observed
